dataset: BIRDSAI real nighttime aerial thermal data
citation: Bondi et al., BIRDSAI: A Dataset for Detection and Tracking in Aerial Thermal Infrared Videos, WACV 2020
label_semantics: Human presence proxy, not authorization or intent. Positive if any original box has class=1; negative if annotated animals are present and no human box is present.
selection: Seed 42, recording-group round robin over annotated frame quartiles. 20 TrainReal calibration images (10/10), 30 TestReal evaluation images (15/15). No synthetic data, ground-truth crop, image enhancement or model-score selection.
limitations: Thermal aerial imagery differs from fixed visible/IR CCTV.
Frames within a recording are correlated; site/individual independence is not established.
Rain, shadows, insects and ordinary authorized humans are not a validated negative set.
